systems.owner: Agency for the Digital Development (ADN), Presidency of the Republic
systems.tiers: About 600 fixed registration centres across the country for six months, at least 2 tablets a centre, 1,500 tablets deployed

systems.system: exceptional regularisation of people registered without a birth certificate
systems.tiers: A law allowed an exceptional process that regularised 2.5 million people enrolled with no identity document, on a document signed on the spot by two witnesses and a municipal officer

systems.system: database of electronic, dematerialized birth certificates
systems.tiers: Created for those regularised; printed birth certificates being delivered

note: An undated essay on the biometric identification census: the birth certificates it describes were produced in bulk from identity enrolment under an exceptional law, not entered at an office where a birth is declared, so no fact is recorded.
